title: Uses of Macro Social Theory: A Social Housing Case Study

detail.title: Uses of Macro Social Theory: A Social Housing Case Study
detail.abstract: This article reflects on the use of macro social theoretical perspectives to explain micro social issues, using social housing allocations as a case study. In contrast to a number of social theoretical examinations of social housing allocation schemes in recent years, spanning socio-legal studies, we argue that 'cookie-cutter' theories may overlook other positions and counter-factual scenarios. We draw on a sample of local authority allocation schemes to reflect on the growing category of households (commonly termed 'unhouseables' by housing officers) which are excluded from appearing on such schemes because of their former housing deviance or some other disqualification. We offer a set of reflections grounded in our data, which focus on sustainability. Thus, rather than point to particular rationalities or the like, we offer particular housing issues as explanatory factors-including the declining stock and financial 'competitiveness' of social housing management-as well as a rise in punitiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地反思了使用宏观社会理论解释微观社会问题（以社会住房分配为例）的局限性，指出"一刀切"理论可能忽视其他立场和反事实情景，特别关注被住房官员称为"不可安置"家庭因过往住房违规或其他原因被排除在分配计划之外的现象。
AI.research_question: 宏观社会理论视角在解释微观社会住房分配问题时的适用性和局限性是什么？特别是对于被排除在分配计划之外的"不可安置"家庭，哪些具体住房问题因素比一般理论更能解释他们的处境？
AI.motivation: 近年来许多社会理论（包括社会法律研究）对社会住房分配计划进行了理论分析，但这些"一刀切"的理论框架可能忽视了其他立场和反事实情景，特别是那些因过往住房违规或其他原因被完全排除在分配计划之外的"不可安置"家庭。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观社会理论在微观社会问题分析中的应用与批判；社会住房分配的社会理论分析；可持续性视角下的住房问题分析。
AI.method: 基于地方当局分配计划样本的反思性分析；对"不可安置"家庭（被住房官员排除在分配计划之外的家庭）的实证数据研究。
AI.findings: 研究发现，与其指向特定的理性或类似理论解释，具体住房问题因素更能解释"不可安置"家庭的处境，包括：社会住房存量下降、社会住房管理的财务"竞争性"增强，以及惩罚性措施的上升。
AI.theory_contributions: 对宏观社会理论在微观社会问题分析中的局限性提供了批判性反思；提出了基于可持续性视角的具体住房问题解释框架，补充了传统社会理论分析；为理解社会住房分配中的排斥机制提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为住房政策制定者提供了关于"不可安置"家庭问题的具体解释因素；指出了社会住房存量下降、管理竞争性和惩罚性措施上升等实际问题；为改善社会住房分配实践提供了基于实证的反思和建议。

title: The Architecture of Moral Misalignment Institutional Corruption, Gender Disparity, and the Restoration of Human Orientation

detail.title: The Architecture of Moral Misalignment Institutional Corruption, Gender Disparity, and the Restoration of Human Orientation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial interests, institutional affiliations, or funding relationships that could have influenced the research presented in this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research is based on institutional observation and structural analysis of governance systems. No human subjects research, experimental procedures, or identifiable personal data were involved; therefore, formal institutional review board approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: The analytical framework and conceptual models presented in this paper were developed by the author based on field observations and comparative institutional analysis conducted between 2008 and 2015.

detail.abstract: Institutional corruption is commonly defined through observable violations such as bribery, abuse of office, or embezzlement. While such definitions capture measurable symptoms, they often fail to identify the structural mechanisms through which corruption becomes normalized across societies. This paper proposes a structural interpretation of corruption as a progressive misalignment between power, responsibility, and accountability. When institutional incentives reward misalignment over integrity, individuals gradually adapt to those incentives until corruption becomes embedded within everyday behavior. Drawing on field observations conducted between 2008 and 2015 within antiscorruption initiatives involving civil society organizations, parliamentary institutions, and international governance environments, this study examines how corruption extends beyond formal institutions into relational domains such as family structures, gender roles, and developmental environments. The analysis argues that gender disparity frequently emerges as an early diagnostic signal of institutional misalignment because relational systems absorb instability before political collapse becomes visible.

AI.tldr: 本文提出腐败的结构性解释：权力、责任与问责之间的渐进性错位。当制度激励奖励错位而非诚信时，腐败会逐渐嵌入日常行为。研究发现性别不平等是制度错位的早期诊断信号。
AI.research_question: 腐败如何超越正式制度扩展到关系领域（家庭结构、性别角色、发展环境），以及性别不平等为何成为制度错位的早期诊断信号？
AI.motivation: 传统腐败定义（如贿赂、滥用职权）只关注可观测的违规行为，但无法识别腐败在社会中正常化的结构性机制。需要理解腐败如何嵌入日常行为和社会关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构性腐败理论：腐败是权力、责任与问责之间的渐进性错位。制度激励理论：当制度奖励错位而非诚信时，个体会逐渐适应这些激励。关系领域理论：腐败扩展到家庭、性别角色等非正式领域。
AI.method: 2008-2015年间在反腐败倡议中的实地观察，涉及公民社会组织、议会机构和国际治理环境。通过多案例研究分析腐败在正式制度和关系领域的表现。
AI.findings: 1. 腐败超越正式制度扩展到家庭结构、性别角色和发展环境等关系领域；2. 性别不平等是制度错位的早期诊断信号，因为关系系统在政治崩溃显现前吸收不稳定性；3. 当制度激励奖励错位时，腐败会逐渐嵌入日常行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出腐败的结构性解释框架；2. 发展制度错位理论；3. 建立性别不平等与制度腐败的关联理论；4. 扩展腐败研究到关系领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为反腐败政策提供早期预警指标（性别不平等）；2. 帮助设计更有效的制度激励机制；3. 指导公民社会组织和国际机构识别结构性腐败；4. 促进跨部门反腐败合作。

title: The Homelessness Reduction Act 2017: Furthering not Fracturing Marginalisation of those Experiencing Homelessness

detail.title: The Homelessness Reduction Act 2017: Furthering not Fracturing Marginalisation of those Experiencing Homelessness
detail.abstract: The Homelessness Reduction Act 2017 represents the most significant change to the rights of homeless people in England for decades. Through an analysis of the history of homelessness legislation in England, but focusing on the 'ground-breaking' 2017 Act, this article explores how the homeless population is represented and 'constructed' in this new legislation and what this tells us about the place of homeless people in our society. In so doing, this article exposes how the 2017 Act, a State instrument of apparent homelessness prevention, can be read and understood as contributing to rather than obviating the marginalisation and social exclusion of homeless people.

AI.tldr: 《2017年无家可归者减少法案》是英格兰几十年来对无家可归者权利最重要的变革，但分析表明该法案实际上加剧而非缓解了无家可归者的边缘化和社会排斥。
AI.research_question: 《2017年无家可归者减少法案》如何构建和表征无家可归者群体？这揭示了无家可归者在社会中的何种地位？
AI.motivation: 该法案被宣传为"开创性"的无家可归预防措施，但需要批判性分析其实际如何影响无家可归者的社会地位和权利。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会建构理论、边缘化理论、社会排斥理论、立法分析框架
AI.method: 通过对英格兰无家可归立法的历史分析，特别聚焦2017年法案的文本和影响分析
AI.findings: 2017年法案虽然表面上是无家可归预防工具，但实际上通过特定的表征和构建方式，加剧了无家可归者的边缘化和社会排斥
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了立法如何通过话语和表征构建社会群体，批判性地分析了"预防性"政策可能产生的反效果
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供警示：表面进步的立法可能隐藏着强化社会不平等的问题，需要更深入的社会包容性政策设计

title: Augmenting Survey Data with Generative AI: An Application to Economic Research
affiliations: National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER), Stanford University,  and Stanford University

detail.title: Augmenting Survey Data with Generative AI: An Application to Economic Research
detail.abstract: We study the potential of large language models (LLMs) to augment survey data collected from human subjects, by focusing on two applications: (1) estimating willingness-to-accept (WTA) for giving up digital and traditional goods, and (2) predicting personal income levels. We find that supplying LLMs with rich contextual data beyond demographics significantly improves predictive accuracy. Model fine tuning and retrieval augmented generation (RAG) further enhance performance, while changes to model temperature or prompting strategies yield only marginal improvements. Performance varies across goods studied and demographic groups. We provide a methodological blueprint for deploying LLMs as a fast, low cost multiplier of survey coverage. This is increasingly valuable given the rapid decline in survey response rates.

AI.tldr: LLMs可用于增强调查数据，通过提供丰富上下文信息显著提高对数字/传统商品支付意愿和个人收入的预测准确性，为应对调查响应率下降提供低成本解决方案。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型（LLMs）如何增强人类调查数据，特别是在估计数字/传统商品的支付意愿（WTA）和预测个人收入水平方面的应用潜力？
AI.motivation: 调查响应率快速下降，需要寻找快速、低成本的替代方案来扩大调查覆盖范围，LLMs作为数据增强工具具有潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于大型语言模型的数据增强理论，结合检索增强生成（RAG）和模型微调技术，探索LLMs在社会科学调查中的应用框架。
AI.method: 使用LLMs进行两项应用研究：1）估计数字和传统商品的支付意愿（WTA）；2）预测个人收入水平。比较不同方法：提供丰富上下文数据、模型微调、RAG、调整模型温度、提示策略等。
AI.findings: 1）为LLMs提供超越人口统计学的丰富上下文数据显著提高预测准确性；2）模型微调和RAG进一步改善性能；3）调整模型温度或提示策略仅带来边际改进；4）性能因商品类型和人口群体而异。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了LLMs作为调查数据增强工具的理论框架，展示了上下文信息在LLM预测中的重要性，为LLMs在社会科学研究中的应用提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了部署LLMs作为快速、低成本调查覆盖倍增器的方法论蓝图，为应对调查响应率下降提供了实用解决方案，特别适用于数字/传统商品估值和个人收入预测等应用场景。

title: Exploring Legal Dimensions in Digital Linguistics
affiliations: KU Leuven - Centre for IT & IP Law (CiTiP) and Centre for IT & IP Law (CiTiP), Faculty of Law - KU Leuven

detail.title: Exploring Legal Dimensions in Digital Linguistics

declarations.funderStatement: Leona King is funded by the Research Foundation – Flanders (FWO) [grant no. 11A0025N].

detail.abstract:
Digital linguistics increasingly relies on large-scale, heterogeneous language data drawn from online platforms, archives, and research infrastructures – data that may be personal, sensitive, creative, or subject to restrictions on access and reuse. Under EU data and digital legislation, however, “language data” is not recognised as a distinct legal category. Instead, linguistic research is shaped by a dense and evolving set of intersecting regulatory regimes that were not designed with linguistics in mind but nonetheless structure what researchers may collect, process, share, and publish. This chapter offers a structured, practice-oriented guide to the legal frameworks most relevant to digital linguistic research.

It explains how the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)’s broad notions of personal data and processing apply to common research workflows; how copyright and the sui generis database right affect corpus construction and redistribution; and how the text and data mining (TDM) exceptions introduced by the Copyright in the Digital Single Market Directive (CDSMD) aim to recalibrate lawful computational analysis. The chapter then situates language data within the EU’s newer data governance and platform regulation landscape, covering the Open Data Directive (ODD), the Data Governance Act (DGA), the Data Act (DA), and the Digital Markets Act (DMA) and Digital Services Act (DSA), and discusses the emerging role of Common European Data Spaces, particularly the European Language Data Space. Finally, it outlines how the AI Act’s data governance and transparency requirements may affect language technologies and linguistic datasets. The chapter concludes by synthesising cross-regime themes and identifying scenarios in which legal consultation may be advisable for researchers.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了欧盟数字立法对语言数据研究的法律影响，分析了GDPR、版权法、数据挖掘例外条款及新兴数据治理框架如何塑造语言学研究实践。
AI.research_question: 欧盟数字立法框架如何影响数字语言学研究中的数据收集、处理、共享和发布？
AI.motivation: 数字语言学依赖大规模、异质性语言数据，但这些数据常涉及个人隐私、版权等法律问题。欧盟法律未将"语言数据"作为独立类别，研究者面临复杂且不断演变的监管环境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟数据治理理论框架，包括数据保护法（GDPR）、知识产权法（版权、数据库权）、数据挖掘例外条款（CDSMD）、开放数据政策（ODD、DGA、DA）以及平台监管（DMA、DSA）。
AI.method: 法律框架分析与综合方法，系统梳理欧盟相关法规对语言数据研究的影响，采用实践导向的指南式分析。
AI.findings: 1. GDPR对个人数据的广泛定义影响研究流程；2. 版权和数据库权限制语料库构建与分发；3. CDSMD的文本数据挖掘例外条款促进计算分析；4. 新兴数据治理框架（DGA、DA等）塑造数据共享环境；5. AI Act将影响语言技术和数据集治理。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了语言数据研究的法律分析框架，揭示了多法规交叉影响的研究实践，为数字语言学法律合规提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者提供实践导向的法律合规指南，识别需要法律咨询的研究场景，帮助研究者应对复杂的欧盟数字法规环境。

title: Fracture behavior and fracture parameter evaluation of notched specimens made from basalt fiber /glass fiber hybrid composite laminates
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Fracture behavior and fracture parameter evaluation of notched specimens made from basalt fiber /glass fiber hybrid composite laminates
detail.abstract: In practical engineering applications, surface scratch defects are inevitably introduced into basalt fiber/glass fiber hybrid composite laminates. Under sustained external loading, these defects may progressively evolve into fracture failure, posing a potential threat to structural safety. To address this issue, a closed-form nonlinear fracture mechanics solution is employed to predict the fracture performance of hybrid composite laminates containing initial scratch defects. Based on the load-displacement curves of three-point bending specimens and CT image analysis of representative specimens, the fracture process consists of a linear stage, a softening stage, and a failure stage. By comparing normal, Weibull, and lognormal distributions, the normal distribution is identified as the most suitable model for describing the variability of fracture parameters. Accordingly, fracture parameters are statistically evaluated at a 95% confidence level. By comparing different parameter evaluation strategies, the characteristic composite unit [[EQUATION]] defined using the weighted average method exhibits higher prediction accuracy within the scope of the present study. The tensile strength [[EQUATION]] and equivalent crack [[EQUATION]] first increase and then decrease with increasing crack-thickness ratio [[EQUATION]] within the tested range. Furthermore, under the investigated material system and loading condition, the fracture behavior of full-size specimens can be reasonably predicted using parameters derived from a single set of small-scale notched specimens, indicating the potential applicability of the proposed approach for predicting the fracture performance of large composite structural components.

AI.tldr: 本文采用闭合形式非线性断裂力学方法预测含初始划痕缺陷的玄武岩纤维/玻璃纤维混杂复合材料层合板的断裂性能。通过三点弯曲试验和CT图像分析，识别了断裂过程的三个阶段，并确定了正态分布最适合描述断裂参数变异性。研究发现，加权平均法定义的复合材料特征单元具有更高的预测精度，且单组小尺度缺口试样的参数可合理预测全尺寸试样的断裂行为。
AI.research_question: 如何预测含初始表面划痕缺陷的玄武岩纤维/玻璃纤维混杂复合材料层合板的断裂性能？
AI.motivation: 在实际工程应用中，玄武岩纤维/玻璃纤维混杂复合材料层合板不可避免地会引入表面划痕缺陷。在持续外部载荷作用下，这些缺陷可能逐渐演变为断裂失效，对结构安全构成潜在威胁。
AI.theoretical_framework: 闭合形式非线性断裂力学理论，用于预测含初始缺陷的复合材料断裂性能。
AI.method: 采用三点弯曲试样的载荷-位移曲线和代表性试样的CT图像分析，识别断裂过程阶段；比较正态分布、威布尔分布和对数正态分布，确定最适合描述断裂参数变异性的统计模型；在95%置信水平下统计评估断裂参数；比较不同参数评估策略。
AI.findings: 1. 断裂过程包括线性阶段、软化阶段和失效阶段；2. 正态分布最适合描述断裂参数变异性；3. 使用加权平均法定义的复合材料特征单元[[EQUATION]]在本文研究范围内具有更高的预测精度；4. 拉伸强度[[EQUATION]]和等效裂纹[[EQUATION]]在测试范围内随裂纹厚度比[[EQUATION]]先增加后减小；5. 在研究的材料体系和加载条件下，使用单组小尺度缺口试样获得的参数可以合理预测全尺寸试样的断裂行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了适用于含初始划痕缺陷混杂复合材料层合板的非线性断裂力学预测方法；2. 确定了断裂参数变异性的最佳统计分布模型；3. 提出了基于加权平均法的复合材料特征单元定义方法，提高了预测精度。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为工程实践中含缺陷复合材料结构的断裂性能评估提供了实用方法；2. 证明了使用小尺度试样参数预测大尺寸结构组件断裂性能的可行性，降低了测试成本；3. 为复合材料结构的安全设计和寿命评估提供了技术支撑。

title: Migration and Long-Term Demographic Change: Can We Control the Numbers?
affiliations: Monash University and Paderborn University

detail.title: Migration and Long-Term Demographic Change: Can We Control the Numbers?
detail.abstract: In many Western societies, mass immigration has been one of the most divisive policy issues in recent years. Seemingly moderate inflows of migrants can have substantial demographic consequences in the long run, due to (1) higher fertility of the migrant population, (2) its younger age distribution, and (3) the possibility of family reunification. Yet, demography hardly appears in the policy debate, even in media outlets that are critical of mass immigration. This may indicate that the mechanics of population dynamics are not widely understood. We design a laboratory experiment in which we confront subjects with 30 different migration scenarios. Subjects have to decide when to stop a given inflow of migrants to achieve a target share of migrants after 60 years. In line with all our pre-registered hypotheses, in scenarios that contain elements of usual mass immigration the growth of the migrant population is systematically underestimated. This bias is even stronger in scenarios that closely resemble the German situation since the opening of the borders during the 2015 refugee crisis.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过实验室实验发现，在涉及大规模移民的情境中，人们系统性地低估移民人口的长期增长，尤其是在类似德国2015年难民危机的情境下。
AI.research_question: 人们是否理解移民对人口结构的长期影响？在涉及大规模移民的情境中，人们是否会系统性地低估移民人口的长期增长？
AI.motivation: 在许多西方社会，大规模移民已成为最具争议的政策议题之一。移民流入看似温和，但由于移民人口更高的生育率、更年轻的年龄结构以及家庭团聚的可能性，长期来看会对人口结构产生重大影响。然而，人口学因素在政策辩论中很少出现，即使是批评大规模移民的媒体也极少提及，这可能表明人们对人口动态机制缺乏理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人口动态理论（包括生育率差异、年龄结构效应和家庭团聚机制）；认知偏差理论（特别是对指数增长的低估）；移民政策决策理论。
AI.method: 实验室实验设计，向被试呈现30种不同的移民情境。被试需要决定何时停止给定的移民流入，以达到60年后移民人口的目标比例。实验包含预注册的假设，特别关注类似德国2015年难民危机的情境。
AI.findings: 与所有预注册假设一致，在包含通常大规模移民要素的情境中，移民人口的增长被系统性地低估。这种偏差在类似德国2015年难民危机的情境中更为强烈。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了人们对移民人口动态的认知偏差；为理解移民政策辩论中人口学因素缺失提供了认知心理学解释；扩展了人们对指数增长低估现象在移民政策领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于公众对移民人口增长理解偏差的证据；建议在移民政策辩论中加强人口学教育；为媒体和公众讨论提供了更准确的人口动态信息基础。

title: Transitional Justice and Human Rights: The Role of Lawyers in Promoting Accountability and Reconciliation

detail.title: Transitional Justice and Human Rights: The Role of Lawyers in Promoting Accountability and Reconciliation
detail.abstract:
Transitional justice is a mechanism in human rights protection developed to help societies rectify large-scale human rights violations, ensuring accountability, serving justice and bringing reconciliation to the victims of the human rights violations and the society at large (Secretary-General, United Nations, 2010). The process involves a range of permanent and temporary institutions and state or non-state actors. These participants may be international and domestic institutions, such as courts, ad hoc tribunals, commissions of inquiry, non-governmental organizations, and even key stakeholders such as lawyers (Jeffery and Dannhauer, 2024), (Chenou et al., 2019).

Importantly, lawyers play an important role in achieving the promotion of accountability and reconciliation in instances of human rights violations post-conflict situations. This is because lawyers are a necessity in the justice system. In this article, the critical roles that lawyers play is examined vis-à-vis the intersection of transitional justice and human rights.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨律师在过渡正义机制中的关键作用，特别是在人权保护、问责与和解方面的贡献。
AI.research_question: 律师在过渡正义与人权交叉领域扮演什么关键角色？
AI.motivation: 过渡正义是保护人权的重要机制，需要各种参与者的协作。律师作为司法系统的必要组成部分，在冲突后人权侵犯的问责与和解中具有重要作用，但这一角色的具体内涵需要系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于联合国过渡正义框架（2010年），结合Jeffery和Dannhauer（2024）以及Chenou等人（2019）关于过渡正义参与者的理论，探讨律师在司法系统中的专业角色理论。
AI.method: 理论分析/概念性研究，通过文献综述和理论框架构建，分析律师在过渡正义中的角色定位。
AI.findings: 律师在过渡正义机制中扮演多重关键角色：作为司法系统必要参与者，在人权侵犯后促进问责与和解；作为国际和国内机构的桥梁；在法庭、特设法庭、调查委员会等机构中发挥专业作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对过渡正义参与者理论的理解，特别强调了律师在人权保护机制中的专业角色；丰富了过渡正义与司法系统交叉领域的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为过渡正义实践提供指导：明确律师在冲突后人权保护中的具体职责；为国际和国内机构在过渡正义过程中有效利用律师专业能力提供参考；促进更有效的问责与和解机制建设。

title: Sociogrowth and Whiteness as Growth
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Sociogrowth and Whiteness as Growth
detail.abstract: Growthism is cardinal and core to contemporary society, particularly under capitalist regimes where wealth accumulation and resource exploitation are pursued with a logic of infinite expansion. Degrowth scholars have engaged in both academic and activist deliberations on the dangers of perpetual economic growth, forming political coalitions and producing a range of literature. What critiques of growth often lack is a sociological and critical race theory lens, or references to race altogether, despite the very nature of capitalism being racialized. In this paper, whiteness is understood as having developed alongside growthist capitalism, not as isolated instruments but as an aggregate. In fact, whiteness has and continues to operate ideologically and materially as growth. From chattel slavery and land theft to the wages of whiteness, this racial invention is deeply tied to economic growth, and transcending white dominance and growth economics must be pursued in tandem.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地分析了增长主义与白人至上主义的共生关系，指出资本主义增长逻辑本质上是种族化的，白人身份作为增长的物质和意识形态工具，超越白人统治必须与超越增长经济学同步进行。
AI.research_question: 增长主义与白人至上主义如何相互构成？超越白人统治与超越增长经济学为何必须同步进行？
AI.motivation: 现有对增长的批判往往缺乏社会学和批判种族理论视角，忽略了资本主义本质上是种族化的，白人身份与增长主义资本主义共同发展，需要揭示这种共生关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判种族理论、去增长理论、社会学分析、白人研究、种族资本主义理论
AI.method: 理论分析、历史分析、文献综述、概念分析
AI.findings: 白人身份从奴隶制、土地掠夺到"白人工资"等历史实践，在意识形态和物质层面都作为增长运作；白人至上主义与增长主义资本主义是相互构成的聚合体，而非孤立工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 为去增长研究提供批判种族理论视角，揭示增长主义的种族化本质，建立白人至上主义与增长主义的理论联系，丰富种族资本主义理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为反种族主义与去增长运动提供联合策略，指出社会变革必须同时挑战白人统治和增长经济学，为跨运动联盟提供理论基础。

title: The Stock Market Participation Puzzle: What Do We Know and Where Do We Go from Here?
affiliations: Monash University, Universiti Utara Malaysia and Universiti Utara Malaysia

detail.title: The Stock Market Participation Puzzle: What Do We Know and Where Do We Go from Here?

publicationDetails.detailsText: No, the paper has not been accepted anywhere

detail.abstract: We review the literature on the stock market participation puzzle, which is the phenomenon that many households do not invest in stocks. Participation is around 37 percent in the US and is much lower in most other countries, especially in developing economics. Explanations include a lack of financial literacy, sociability, trust, health, and cognitive abilities. Given that most of these factors are correlated, we suggest that future studies focus on finding a hierarchy of explanations that explain the puzzle.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了股票市场参与之谜的相关文献，即许多家庭不投资股票的现象。美国参与率约37%，其他国家尤其是发展中国家更低。解释因素包括金融素养、社交性、信任、健康和认知能力等，这些因素相互关联，建议未来研究应寻找解释该谜题的解释层次。
AI.research_question: 股票市场参与之谜是什么？为什么许多家庭不投资股票？哪些因素可以解释这一现象？
AI.motivation: 股票市场参与率普遍较低（美国约37%，其他国家更低），这一现象被称为"参与之谜"，需要系统梳理现有解释并指导未来研究方向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学、家庭金融理论、社会资本理论、信任理论、认知能力理论等。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，系统梳理和分析现有关于股票市场参与之谜的研究。
AI.findings: 1. 股票市场参与率存在显著的国际差异；2. 主要解释因素包括金融素养不足、社交性缺乏、信任缺失、健康问题和认知能力限制；3. 这些解释因素之间存在相关性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统梳理了股票市场参与之谜的多种解释理论；2. 指出各解释因素之间的相关性；3. 提出了寻找解释层次的研究方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供改善股票市场参与率的参考因素；2. 为金融机构设计更包容的投资产品提供理论依据；3. 帮助理解家庭金融决策的复杂性。

title: Maintaining Reality Contact in Bounded Systems: Suppression, Distortion, and Proxy Hijack
affiliations: UNSW Business School

detail.title: Maintaining Reality Contact in Bounded Systems: Suppression, Distortion, and Proxy Hijack
detail.abstract: Finite agents act through representations that incompletely track the generative processes they depend on. Some mismatch is therefore inevitable. The practical problem is not error per se, but degradation of the discrepancy channels that normally maintain reality contact. I propose a compact topology of discrepancy-driven failure in bounded systems, distinguishing three loci: suppression (relevant discrepancies fail to enter updating), distortion (discrepancies are systematically recoded before revision), and proxy hijack (optimisation concentrates on a proxy signal that is imperfectly coupled to the latent objective). The framework organises dispersed phenomena across psychology, organisations, economics, and artificial systems around discrepancy-channel integrity rather than domain-specific mechanisms. It generates dissociable process signatures, regime conditions for proxy-latent divergence, and mode-matched intervention predictions. The analysis motivates truth literacy as a transferable competence for preserving corrigibility under uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个关于有限系统中基于差异驱动的失败拓扑结构，区分了三种失败模式：抑制、扭曲和代理劫持，强调差异通道完整性而非领域特定机制，并提倡"真相素养"作为在不确定性下保持可修正性的可转移能力。
AI.research_question: 有限系统如何因差异通道失效而导致现实接触退化？如何系统分类这些失败模式并提出干预策略？
AI.motivation: 有限代理通过不完全跟踪其所依赖的生成过程的表征来行动，因此必然存在不匹配。实际问题不是错误本身，而是维持现实接触的差异通道的退化。需要系统理解这种退化机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于差异驱动的失败拓扑理论，区分三种失败模式：抑制（相关差异未能进入更新）、扭曲（差异在修订前被系统性地重新编码）、代理劫持（优化集中在与潜在目标不完全耦合的代理信号上）。
AI.method: 概念分析框架，通过理论推导构建拓扑结构，整合心理学、组织学、经济学和人工系统中的分散现象，围绕差异通道完整性而非领域特定机制进行组织。
AI.findings: 该框架能够组织跨领域的分散现象，生成可分离的过程特征、代理-潜在目标分歧的制度条件，以及模式匹配的干预预测。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个紧凑的差异驱动失败拓扑理论，为理解有限系统中的现实接触退化提供了统一框架，强调差异通道完整性而非具体机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 该分析提倡"真相素养"作为在不确定性下保持可修正性的可转移能力，为跨领域系统设计提供了干预策略和预测工具。

title: Decentralized Admissibility: Slack, Inheritance, and the Necessity of Memory
affiliations: Friedrich Schiller University - Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science

detail.title: Decentralized Admissibility: Slack, Inheritance, and the Necessity of Memory
detail.abstract:
This paper studies the persistence of admissibility in decentralized environments with population turnover and verification lag. At each date, spatial robustness requires that an alternative be supported by at least k agents providing η-interior slack. We show that when admissibility depends only on contemporaneous signals-historyblindness-verification lag generates a structural handoff gap. Even if primitive slack is perfectly preserved across time, the replacement of a verified agent by an entrant can render a previously pivotal alternative inadmissible. The failure is purely informational: contemporaneous signals are not a sufficient statistic for preserved primitive slack. 
We prove that no history-blind, spatially robust rule can guarantee continuity across such handoffs. Restoring persistence requires enlarging the informational domain. We characterize the Public Core-the set of previously admissible alternatives-as the minimal public state that bridges verification lag. Institutional memory is therefore not an auxiliary feature of decentralized design, but an informational lower bound imposed by verification frictions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在人口流动和验证延迟的去中心化环境中，可采纳性的持续性。研究发现，当可采纳性仅依赖于同期信号时，验证延迟会产生结构性交接缺口，即使原始松弛度完美保留，已验证代理被新进入者替代也可能使先前关键方案变得不可采纳。恢复持续性需要扩大信息域，公共核心（先前可采纳方案的集合）是连接验证延迟的最小公共状态。
AI.research_question: 在人口流动和验证延迟的去中心化环境中，如何确保可采纳性（admissibility）的持续性？
AI.motivation: 在去中心化环境中，人口流动和验证延迟可能导致先前可采纳的方案变得不可采纳，这种失败纯粹是信息性的，需要理解如何通过制度设计来维持决策的连续性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于去中心化决策理论、空间鲁棒性（spatial robustness）、验证延迟（verification lag）、历史盲性（history-blindness）和公共核心（Public Core）等概念。
AI.method: 理论证明和形式化分析，研究在历史盲性、空间鲁棒性规则下，验证延迟如何导致交接缺口，并分析恢复持续性所需的信息扩展。
AI.findings: 1. 当可采纳性仅依赖于同期信号时，验证延迟会产生结构性交接缺口；2. 即使原始松弛度完美保留，已验证代理被新进入者替代也可能使先前关键方案变得不可采纳；3. 任何历史盲性、空间鲁棒性规则都无法保证跨交接的连续性；4. 恢复持续性需要扩大信息域，公共核心是连接验证延迟的最小公共状态。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 形式化了验证延迟导致的交接缺口问题；2. 证明了历史盲性规则在维持可采纳性持续性方面的局限性；3. 提出了公共核心作为解决验证延迟的最小信息扩展；4. 将制度记忆从辅助特征重新定位为验证摩擦强加的信息下界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为去中心化系统的设计提供了重要启示：制度记忆不是可选功能，而是应对验证延迟的必要信息基础设施，需要在系统设计中内置公共状态记录机制来维持决策连续性。

title: From Corporate Processes to State Institutions: Corporate-State Metabolism in Modern Governance

detail.title: From Corporate Processes to State Institutions: Corporate-State Metabolism in Modern Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no financial or personal conflicts of interest relevant to this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based solely on published historical sources and secondary literature. It does not involve human participants, clinical data, or identifiable personal information and therefore did not require ethics committee approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper develops corporate-state metabolism to explain how public institutions absorb and transform governance technologies first tested in private-order settings. It traces a long arc from feudal and mercantile instruments (contracts, accounting, merchant courts) into early public law, and reads the American founding as a metabolic condenser that repackaged colonial self-government, corporate charters, and religious associational templates into scalable constitutional architecture. In the digital era, a pressure gradient between fast enterprise systems and slow public workflows drives states toward ERP, portals, and case-management platforms-while importing risks of vendor lock-in, surveillance, and bureaucratic self-preservation. The paper argues that bureaucracies selectively adopt tools that protect resources and discretion while resisting those that increase responsibility or make failure legible; when external filters weaken, the system can cross a threshold into a terminal bureaucracy that drains a weakening society and collapses into fragmented, oligarchic order.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"公司-国家新陈代谢"理论，解释公共机构如何吸收和转化最初在私人秩序环境中测试的治理技术。从封建和商业工具到早期公法，再到美国建国作为"代谢冷凝器"，以及数字时代企业系统与公共工作流程之间的压力梯度，最终可能导致"终端官僚主义"的崩溃。
AI.research_question: 公共机构如何吸收和转化最初在私人秩序环境中测试的治理技术？这种吸收过程如何影响官僚机构的行为和最终可能导致系统崩溃？
AI.motivation: 理解数字时代公共部门采用企业技术（如ERP、门户网站、案件管理平台）的现象，以及这种技术转移带来的风险（供应商锁定、监控、官僚自我保护）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公司-国家新陈代谢理论，压力梯度模型，终端官僚主义概念，选择性采用理论。
AI.method: 历史追踪分析（从封建和商业工具到早期公法），案例研究（美国建国作为"代谢冷凝器"），当代数字技术采用分析。
AI.findings: 1. 官僚机构选择性采用保护资源和自由裁量权的工具，抵制增加责任或使失败可见的工具；2. 当外部过滤器减弱时，系统可能跨越阈值进入"终端官僚主义"；3. 终端官僚主义会耗尽衰弱的社会，最终崩溃为碎片化的寡头秩序。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"公司-国家新陈代谢"理论框架，解释了治理技术从私人到公共领域的转移过程；发展了"终端官僚主义"概念，描述了官僚系统崩溃的临界点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了识别官僚机构技术采用偏好的框架；警示了数字技术采用可能带来的风险（供应商锁定、监控、官僚自我保护）；提供了预防"终端官僚主义"崩溃的见解。

title: Optimization of Next-Generation 911 Systems Using Real-Time Geospatial Analytics

detail.title: Optimization of Next-Generation 911 Systems Using Real-Time Geospatial Analytics

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare the sole authorship of this paper
declarations.ethicsApproval: I declare the sole authorship of this paper
declarations.funderStatement: I declare the sole authorship of this paper
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: I declare the sole authorship of this paper

detail.abstract: The rapid urbanization and increasing complexity of modern cities demand innovative approaches to emergency response. This study investigates how Next-Generation 911 (NG911) systems can be optimized through the integration of real-time geospatial analytics and predictive routing algorithms. By synthesizing empirical research, system simulations, and GIS-based data analyses, the study evaluates how real-time mapping, sensor integration, and AI-driven routing enhance response times and resource allocation. Findings indicate that NG911 systems equipped with detailed geospatial analytics reduce average response times by 15-25%, improve emergency resource distribution, and increase operational resilience. Unexpected limitations, such as incomplete indoor maps and signal interference in urban environments, were identified as key areas requiring further research. The study concludes that effective NG911 optimization requires a holistic integration of geospatial intelligence, predictive analytics, and continuous data updates. Policymakers and emergency management agencies must prioritize investment in AI-enhanced GIS systems and inter-agency data sharing to maximize public safety outcomes

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨如何通过整合实时地理空间分析和预测性路由算法来优化下一代911系统，发现这种优化能够将平均响应时间减少15-25%，改善应急资源分配，并提高运营韧性。
AI.research_question: 如何通过整合实时地理空间分析和预测性路由算法来优化下一代911（NG911）系统？
AI.motivation: 快速城市化和现代城市日益增长的复杂性要求应急响应采取创新方法，需要研究如何利用先进技术优化紧急服务系统。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地理信息系统（GIS）理论、实时数据分析理论、预测性路由算法理论、应急管理系统理论
AI.method: 综合实证研究、系统模拟和基于GIS的数据分析，评估实时地图、传感器集成和AI驱动路由对响应时间和资源分配的影响
AI.findings: 配备详细地理空间分析的NG911系统可将平均响应时间减少15-25%，改善应急资源分配，提高运营韧性；但发现室内地图不完整和城市环境信号干扰等限制因素
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了整合地理空间智能、预测分析和持续数据更新的NG911系统优化框架，为应急管理系统理论提供了实证支持
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和应急管理机构提供具体建议：优先投资AI增强的GIS系统和跨机构数据共享，以最大化公共安全成果

title: Heatwaves, Coldwaves, Floods, and Droughts: The Short-Term Impact of Extreme Weather Events on Economic Activity
affiliations: , European Central Bank (ECB) and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Heatwaves, Coldwaves, Floods, and Droughts: The Short-Term Impact of Extreme Weather Events on Economic Activity
detail.abstract: This paper examines the short-term macroeconomic and sectoral effects of extreme weather events in Germany, France, Italy, and Spain. We construct novel indicators of extreme temperature and precipitation based on percentile thresholds of long-run historical distributions and estimate their impact through country-specific structural Bayesian VAR models. The analysis documents sizable and heterogeneous effects on real GDP, HICP, and sectoral activity over a one-year horizon. Temperature extremes primarily affect industrial and energy-related sectors, with Germany exhibiting the strongest vulnerability to heatwaves. Precipitation extremes mainly impact construction and mining, with Spain featuring the largest exposure to floods and droughts. Sectoral composition plays a key role in shaping transmission, with pharmaceuticals, electricity, construction, and mining displaying distinct and recurrent patterns. Given their impact on prices, extreme weather event shocks may exert inflationary pressures without hurting activity, or induce demand-type of effects on the overall economy, with different effects across countries.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了德国、法国、意大利和西班牙极端天气事件的短期宏观经济和部门效应，发现温度极端主要影响工业和能源部门，降水极端主要影响建筑和采矿部门，且各国受影响程度存在显著差异。
AI.research_question: 极端天气事件对德国、法国、意大利和西班牙的短期宏观经济和部门活动有何影响？这些影响在不同国家和部门之间如何变化？
AI.motivation: 随着气候变化加剧，极端天气事件日益频繁，了解其对欧洲主要经济体的经济影响对于制定适应政策和风险管理至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于长期历史分布百分位数阈值构建极端温度和降水指标，采用结构贝叶斯VAR模型分析宏观经济冲击传导机制。
AI.method: 构建基于长期历史分布百分位数阈值的极端温度和降水新指标，采用国家特定的结构贝叶斯VAR模型进行估计，分析一年期内的经济影响。
AI.findings: 1. 温度极端主要影响工业和能源相关部门，德国对热浪最为脆弱；2. 降水极端主要影响建筑和采矿部门，西班牙对洪水和干旱暴露最大；3. 部门构成在传导中起关键作用，制药、电力、建筑和采矿部门显示出独特且反复出现的模式；4. 极端天气可能通过价格渠道产生通胀压力而不损害经济活动，或对整体经济产生需求型效应，且各国效应不同。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了基于历史分布百分位数阈值的极端天气指标构建方法；2. 揭示了极端天气对不同经济部门异质性影响的传导机制；3. 提供了极端天气通过价格渠道和需求渠道影响宏观经济的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供极端天气经济风险评估工具；2. 帮助企业和投资者识别气候风险暴露部门；3. 为国家制定气候适应策略提供实证依据；4. 为中央银行考虑气候因素的通胀管理提供参考。

title: Housing Wealth and Monetary Policy Transmission: Cross-Country Evidence
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB) and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Housing Wealth and Monetary Policy Transmission: Cross-Country Evidence
detail.abstract: This paper quantifies the role of housing wealth in the transmission of monetary policy to consumption in 20 advanced economies. Using Bayesian VAR models we identify structural shocks with a novel combination of sign and maximum forecast error variance restrictions, isolating the housing wealth channel through counterfactual impulse responses. We find that the housing wealth multiplier — the sensitivity of consumption to exogenous house price changes — is strongly correlated with outright homeownership rates and is higher for durable consumption. Cross-country differences in the monetary policy transmission to consumption are largely driven by the cash-flow channel.

AI.tldr: 该研究量化了住房财富在货币政策传导至消费中的作用，发现住房财富乘数与直接住房拥有率高度相关，且耐用消费对房价变化更敏感。跨国差异主要由现金流渠道驱动。
AI.research_question: 住房财富在货币政策传导至消费中扮演什么角色？住房财富乘数如何随住房拥有率和消费类型变化？跨国差异的主要驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解货币政策如何通过住房财富渠道影响消费对政策制定至关重要，但现有研究对跨国差异和渠道相对重要性缺乏系统量化分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 住房财富渠道理论、货币政策传导机制、财富效应理论、消费函数理论（特别是耐用消费与非耐用消费差异）
AI.method: 使用贝叶斯VAR模型，结合符号限制和最大预测误差方差限制识别结构冲击，通过反事实脉冲响应函数分离住房财富渠道
AI.findings: 1) 住房财富乘数与直接住房拥有率高度正相关；2) 耐用消费对房价外生变化的敏感性更高；3) 货币政策传导至消费的跨国差异主要由现金流渠道驱动
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 系统量化住房财富渠道在货币政策传导中的作用；2) 识别住房财富乘数的关键决定因素；3) 阐明不同消费类型对住房财富冲击的异质性反应
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为央行制定差异化货币政策提供依据；2) 帮助政策制定者理解住房市场对消费的影响机制；3) 为跨国政策协调提供实证基础

title: Managerial Investment and Innovation Transmission in Chinese Manufacturing: Multi-Level Evidence from Firms and Innovation Sectors
affiliations: and University of Chinese Academy of Social Sciences

detail.title: Managerial Investment and Innovation Transmission in Chinese Manufacturing: Multi-Level Evidence from Firms and Innovation Sectors
detail.abstract: Amid narrowing profit margins and intensifying competition in Chinese manufacturing, understanding how innovation is transmitted across firms and production units is essential for explaining industrial upgrading. This paper introduces the concept of innovation sectors beyond traditional industry classifications and constructs a multi-level dataset linking firms to innovation sectors. Using longitudinal firm data from 2003–2014 combined with innovation output indicators in 2025, we employ a two-stage trend estimation approach to examine how long-term input structures affect innovation transmission. The results show that persistent managerial investment significantly promotes innovation transmission at both firm and innovation-sector levels, whereas asset accumulation does not exhibit a stable positive effect. These findings suggest that innovation diffusion in Chinese manufacturing follows a hierarchical and nested pattern: innovation capabilities spread not through capital expansion alone but through organizational accumulation and resource reallocation across firms and sectors. The study provides new multi-level evidence on China’s transition from scale-driven to innovation-driven manufacturing and offers implications for policies aimed at fostering sustainable industrial upgrading.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过构建创新部门概念和多层次数据集，发现中国制造业创新传播遵循分层嵌套模式，管理投资显著促进创新传播，而资产积累无稳定正向效应，为中国从规模驱动向创新驱动转型提供新证据。
AI.research_question: 在中国制造业利润空间收窄、竞争加剧的背景下，创新如何在不同企业和生产单元间传播？长期投入结构如何影响创新传播？
AI.motivation: 中国制造业面临利润空间收窄和竞争加剧的双重压力，理解创新传播机制对解释产业升级至关重要，传统行业分类无法充分捕捉创新动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创新传播理论、产业升级理论、资源基础观、多层次分析框架，引入"创新部门"概念超越传统行业分类。
AI.method: 构建多层次数据集（企业-创新部门链接），使用2003-2014年纵向企业数据与2025年创新产出指标，采用两阶段趋势估计方法分析长期投入结构对创新传播的影响。
AI.findings: 持续性管理投资在企业层面和创新部门层面均显著促进创新传播，而资产积累未表现出稳定的正向效应；中国制造业创新扩散遵循分层嵌套模式，创新能力的传播不仅通过资本扩张，更通过组织积累和跨企业、跨部门的资源重新配置。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"创新部门"概念超越传统行业分类，建立多层次创新传播分析框架，揭示中国制造业创新扩散的分层嵌套模式，丰富产业升级和创新传播理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国从规模驱动向创新驱动制造业转型提供多层次实证证据，为促进可持续产业升级的政策制定提供启示，强调管理投资和组织积累的重要性而非单纯资本扩张。

title: Topological Global Economics: Geometric Equilibrium and Structural Buckling on a Closed
affiliations: SBCM Alliance

detail.title: Topological Global Economics: Geometric Equilibrium and Structural Buckling on a Closed

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a theoretical and empirical study based on publicly available macroeconomic data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper proposes "Topological Global Economics," a dimensional expansion of "Governance Engineering"—previously established for regional resource cycles—to a planetary scale. We formulate the "Flat-Earth Fallacy" inherent in contemporary macroeconomics, which assumes an infinite space where entropy can be discarded externally, ignoring the physical constraints of the Earth's finite surface area (4²). On a closed Riemannian manifold, the dynamic N-Body Problem of economic agents exhibits deterministic chaos; however, we provide a rigorous structural solution by redefining it as a problem of geometric stability via Additively Weighted Spherical Tessellation. Through the construction of a "Planetary Replica" using the economic mass of G7 nations and China, we identify "Economic Fault Lines" arising from the misalignment of mass distribution. Crucially, our model provides a causal geometric explanation for the "residuals" observed in empirical trade networks that traditional gravity models fail to account for. We formalize international trade as a "pressure adjustment valve" at polygon interfaces and conflict as a physical "Structural Buckling" of the system. Furthermore, by defining oceans as "Superconducting Areas" with zero physical resistance, we prove the existence of autonomous multipolar equilibria governed by an invariant autonomy coefficient (a ≈ 0.12). This research moves beyond political rhetoric to offer engineering specifications for a "Planetary OS"—a sustainable, high-velocity resource circulation circuit governed by physical boundary conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"拓扑全球经济"理论，将区域资源循环的"治理工程"扩展到全球尺度。通过构建"地球副本"模型，识别经济断层线，解释传统引力模型无法解释的贸易网络残差，将国际贸易形式化为压力调节阀，冲突视为结构屈曲。
AI.research_question: 如何在有限地球表面（封闭黎曼流形）上建立可持续的全球经济系统？如何解释传统引力模型无法解释的贸易网络残差？如何从几何稳定性角度理解国际经济系统的动态行为？
AI.motivation: 当代宏观经济学存在"平坦地球谬误"，假设无限空间可以外部处理熵增，忽视了地球有限表面积的物理约束。需要建立考虑地球物理边界条件的全球经济工程框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 拓扑全球经济理论、治理工程、封闭黎曼流形上的N体问题、几何稳定性理论、加性加权球面镶嵌、结构屈曲理论、自主多极均衡理论。
AI.method: 使用G7国家和中国的经济质量构建"地球副本"模型，应用加性加权球面镶嵌方法，将经济主体动态问题转化为几何稳定性问题，识别经济断层线，分析贸易网络残差。
AI.findings: 发现经济质量分布错位导致"经济断层线"；贸易网络残差源于几何结构；海洋作为"超导区域"（零物理阻力）；存在由不变自主系数（a≈0.12）支配的自主多极均衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出拓扑全球经济理论框架；形式化"平坦地球谬误"；将国际经济系统建模为封闭黎曼流形上的几何稳定性问题；建立贸易作为压力调节阀、冲突作为结构屈曲的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为"行星操作系统"提供工程规范；识别经济断层线预警系统风险；解释传统模型无法解释的贸易现象；为可持续高速资源循环电路设计提供物理边界条件指导。

title: Signaling Without Signals: Arena Choice Under AI Homogenization
affiliations: Kwansei Gakuin University - School of Sociology

detail.title: Signaling Without Signals: Arena Choice Under AI Homogenization

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by JSPS KAKENHI Grant Number 25K05449.

detail.abstract: When AI homogenizes output, traditional performance signals lose their informational value, and evaluators revert to prior beliefs about social origin, reproducing the condition for statistical discrimination through a different mechanism. We show that individuals respond by strategically choosing costly evaluation arenas that AI cannot homogenize, producing a Spence-type signaling game. We derive the Riley separating equilibrium in closed form under a broad class of cost functions and show that equilibrium payoffs are independent of both the cost parameter and the cost functional form. When prior beliefs are sufficiently favorable, all types prefer the pooling outcome, yet the D1 refinement selects the separating equilibrium, producing a prisoner's dilemma in which signaling makes everyone worse off. Because payoffs are cost-invariant, subsidizing or restricting arena access is ineffective; the model points instead to raising the floor of the ability distribution as the relevant policy lever.

AI.tldr: 当AI同质化产出时，传统绩效信号失去信息价值，评估者回归对出身的先验信念，通过不同机制再现统计歧视条件。个体通过战略选择AI无法同质化的昂贵评估领域来应对，形成斯宾塞型信号博弈。研究发现均衡收益与成本参数和函数形式无关，当先验信念足够有利时，所有类型偏好混同结果，但D1精炼选择分离均衡，产生囚徒困境。政策建议是提高能力分布下限而非补贴或限制领域准入。
AI.research_question: 当AI同质化产出削弱传统绩效信号时，个体如何通过战略选择评估领域来应对？这种信号博弈会产生什么均衡结果？对减少歧视的有效政策干预是什么？
AI.motivation: AI技术能够生成同质化的产出，这削弱了传统绩效信号的信息价值，导致评估者依赖先验信念（如社会出身）进行判断，从而再现统计歧视。需要理解个体如何应对这种变化以及相应的政策含义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 斯宾塞型信号博弈理论、统计歧视理论、博弈论均衡分析（特别是Riley分离均衡和D1精炼）、囚徒困境理论
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建信号博弈模型，在广泛的成本函数类别下推导闭式解的Riley分离均衡，应用D1精炼分析均衡选择
AI.findings: 1. 均衡收益与成本参数和成本函数形式无关；2. 当先验信念足够有利时，所有类型偏好混同结果，但D1精炼选择分离均衡；3. 这产生了囚徒困境，信号传递使所有人境况变差；4. 补贴或限制领域准入无效，提高能力分布下限是有效政策杠杆
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将AI同质化产出与统计歧视机制联系起来；2. 在AI时代重新概念化信号博弈；3. 证明均衡收益的成本不变性；4. 识别D1精炼下的囚徒困境均衡选择
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 指出传统政策工具（补贴或限制领域准入）在AI同质化背景下无效；2. 建议政策重点应放在提高能力分布下限上；3. 为组织设计评估机制提供理论指导

title: Anomaly-Driven Demand
affiliations: Aarhus University - CREATES and Aarhus University - Department of Economics and Business Economics

detail.title: Anomaly-Driven Demand
detail.abstract: We show that trading on anomalies generates price pressure in the underlying stocks. We construct a proxy for anomaly-driven demand (ADD), capturing demand generated when investors rebalance into and out of anomaly long and short legs. Stocks with high ADD earn significantly higher subsequent returns than stocks with low ADD. This effect carries over to anomalies: anomalies whose constituent stocks have the highest ADD earn 8.04 percentage points higher annualized returns than those whose contituent stocks have the lowest ADD. These results suggest that investor demand for anomalies induce price pressure that becomes incorporated into observed anomaly returns.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，基于异象的交易会对标的股票产生价格压力，这种异象驱动需求(ADD)能预测股票和异象组合的未来收益，表明投资者对异象的需求会通过价格压力机制影响已观测的异象收益。
AI.research_question: 基于异象的交易是否会对标的股票产生价格压力？这种价格压力如何影响已观测的异象收益？
AI.motivation: 传统金融理论认为异象收益反映了未被定价的风险或市场无效性，但本文提出另一种解释：投资者对异象的交易行为本身可能通过价格压力机制影响股票价格，从而影响观测到的异象收益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 价格压力理论、行为金融学、市场微观结构理论。文章基于投资者交易行为会产生临时性价格压力的理论框架，探讨异象交易如何通过需求冲击影响股票价格。
AI.method: 构建异象驱动需求(ADD)代理变量，捕捉投资者在异象多头和空头腿之间再平衡时产生的需求。通过横截面回归分析ADD与后续股票收益的关系，并检验ADD对异象组合收益的预测能力。
AI.findings: 1. 高ADD股票后续收益显著高于低ADD股票；2. 构成股票ADD最高的异象组合年化收益比最低的异象组合高出8.04个百分点；3. 投资者对异象的需求会通过价格压力机制影响已观测的异象收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 为异象收益提供了新的理论解释：部分观测到的异象收益可能源于投资者交易行为产生的价格压力，而非纯粹的风险补偿或市场无效性。这挑战了传统异象研究的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供了新的预测工具(ADD)；2. 揭示了异象策略实施时可能面临的价格压力风险；3. 对量化投资策略的设计和风险管理有重要启示。

title: Regional Features of Demographic Dynamics in the Republic of Karelia: Current State and Trends

detail.title: Regional Features of Demographic Dynamics in the Republic of Karelia: Current State and Trends
detail.abstract:
The Republic of Karelia faces a profound demographic crisis characteristic of many subjects within the Northwestern Federal District, yet possessing distinct regional specifics. This study analyzes the dynamics of population size, components of reproduction, and the effectiveness of regional demographic policy for the period 2000–2024.

Statistical analysis reveals a monotonic population decline from 735.5 thousand persons in 2000 to 523.9 thousand in 2024, representing a decrease of 28.8%. Key findings indicate a sustained fertility decline following a 2014 peak, with the Total Fertility Rate reaching 1.35 in 2023, significantly below the replacement level. Mortality rates remain consistently above the national average (16.4‰ in 2023), driven primarily by circulatory diseases and external causes. Consequently, natural population decline reached –8.1‰ in 2024, one of the highest rates in the Russian Federation. Although a migration inflow was recorded from 2021 to 2024 (+3.5–4.1‰), it fails to compensate for natural loss.

The study examines the decentralized governance structure of demographic policy and existing support measures, including maternity capital and family benefits. While social support systems are preserved and migration outflow trends reversed post-2021, critical challenges persist: high mortality among working-age men, absence of long-term migrant retention strategies, and a shrinking cohort of women of fertile age.

The paper concludes that financial incentives alone are insufficient to ensure demographic sustainability. Recommendations include implementing regional programs to reduce suicidality and alcohol consumption, developing psychological support services, creating comprehensive migrant adaptation packages, and enhancing housing policies for young families. Sustainable demographic development in Karelia depends on the integrated improvement of infrastructure, labor markets, and public health preservation measures.

AI.tldr: 卡累利阿共和国面临严重人口危机：2000-2024年人口下降28.8%，生育率低于更替水平，死亡率高于全国平均，自然减少率高达-8.1‰。虽然2021年后有移民流入，但无法弥补自然损失。研究发现仅靠财政激励不足以保证人口可持续性，需要综合改善基础设施、劳动市场和公共卫生措施。
AI.research_question: 卡累利阿共和国2000-2024年人口动态、人口再生产构成及区域人口政策有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 卡累利阿共和国面临西北联邦区典型但具有区域特殊性的人口危机，需要分析人口动态和政策有效性以应对持续的人口下降问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人口再生产理论、区域人口政策分析框架、人口转型理论、人口迁移理论
AI.method: 统计分析方法，分析2000-2024年的人口规模动态、生育率、死亡率、自然增长率和迁移数据，评估区域人口政策效果
AI.findings: 1) 人口持续下降28.8%；2) 生育率从2014年峰值下降至1.35，低于更替水平；3) 死亡率(16.4‰)高于全国平均；4) 自然减少率达-8.1‰；5) 2021年后虽有移民流入(+3.5-4.1‰)，但无法弥补自然损失；6) 现有政策措施不足
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 验证了仅靠财政激励不足以保证区域人口可持续性的理论；2) 提出了区域人口政策需要综合方法的理论框架；3) 丰富了人口危机区域特殊性研究
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 识别了卡累利阿人口危机的具体特征；2) 提出了具体政策建议：减少自杀和酒精消费的区域计划、心理支持服务、移民适应方案、年轻家庭住房政策；3) 强调了基础设施、劳动市场和公共卫生综合改善的重要性

title: Ambition as Insurance: When Task Choice Protects Self-Belief
affiliations: Tinbergen Institute - Tinbergen Institute, Tinbergen Institute Amsterdam (TIA) Students and Nanyang Technological University (NTU) - Division of Economics

detail.title: Ambition as Insurance: When Task Choice Protects Self-Belief

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest to declare.

detail.abstract: Individuals sometimes choose highly ambitious tracks despite low success probabilities. This note proposes an informational mechanism: when failure in extremely competitive environments is less diagnostic of ability than failure in moderately competitive ones, ambitious choice functions as insurance against adverse belief updating. A closed-form characterization of the belief-insurance threshold shows that ambitious choice becomes more attractive when the diagnosticity gap between tasks is large, when the prior probability of high ability is high, and when material stakes are low. Risk-taking in this framework arises not from convex utility but from differences in informational structure.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种信息机制解释：当在极端竞争环境中失败比在中等竞争环境中失败对能力的诊断性更低时，选择雄心勃勃的赛道可以作为防止负面信念更新的保险。这种"信念保险"使得个体即使在成功概率低的情况下也会选择高竞争性任务。
AI.research_question: 为什么个体有时会选择成功概率极低的雄心勃勃的赛道？这种选择背后的信息机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 解释观察到的现象：人们有时会追求成功概率极低的雄心勃勃目标（如进入顶尖学校、竞争激烈的工作等），即使从传统理性选择角度看似乎不合理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于贝叶斯信念更新的信息经济学框架，强调不同任务失败对能力诊断性的差异。提出"信念保险"概念，即选择诊断性较低的任务失败来保护自我信念。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，通过建立形式化模型推导出"信念保险阈值"的闭式解，分析各参数对雄心勃勃选择的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 当任务间诊断性差距大时，雄心勃勃选择更具吸引力；2. 当先验高能力概率高时，更倾向于选择雄心勃勃赛道；3. 当物质利益较低时，信念保险动机更强；4. 风险承担源于信息结构差异而非效用函数凸性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"信念保险"作为解释雄心勃勃选择的新机制；2. 将信息结构差异作为风险承担的新解释；3. 提供形式化模型和闭式解；4. 挑战传统基于效用函数凸性的风险偏好理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 帮助理解个体职业和教育选择行为；2. 为组织设计激励机制提供新视角；3. 解释为什么人们会追求看似不合理的竞争性目标；4. 对教育政策和职业咨询有启示意义。

title: The Legal Implications of Unilateral Formation of an MAOA Association by a Developer After MOFA Sale, and Recovery of Maintenance Dues from Non-Joining Flat Owners!
affiliations: Lex India Juris

detail.title: The Legal Implications of Unilateral Formation of an MAOA Association by a Developer After MOFA Sale, and Recovery of Maintenance Dues from Non-Joining Flat Owners!

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No Interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: No Ethics Approval is required as this is a research paper on law and two concurrent laws comparision
declarations.funderStatement: No Funding

keywords: Legal Research Done by Dr.V.V.L.N. Sastry
and Fulbright Scholar. Dr. Sastry has his LL.B (India)

detail.abstract: A Condominium or Association formed by a developer after execution of Agreements for Sale under the provisions of the Maharashtra Ownership Flats Act, 1963 (MOFA), cannot derive lawful authority unless the 100% original flat purchasers expressly consent to such migration to a Condominium under the Maharashtra Apartment Ownership Act, 1970 (MAOA). In the absence of 100% unanimous consent of all the original MOFA purchasers, such unilateral formation of a Condominium lacks legal validity and may not confer enforceable authority upon the said body, particularly with respect to the collection of maintenance or other charges from the flat purchasers.

AI.tldr: 开发商在《马哈拉施特拉邦公寓所有权法》下组建的公寓协会，若未获得100%原始购房者的明确同意，则缺乏法律效力，无权向购房者收取维护费等费用。
AI.research_question: 在《马哈拉施特拉邦公寓所有权法》下组建的公寓协会，在未获得100%原始购房者同意的情况下，是否具有法律效力？
AI.motivation: 开发商单方面将MOFA协议下的房产转为MAOA下的公寓所有权模式，可能侵犯购房者权益，需要明确法律要求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于《马哈拉施特拉邦公寓所有权法》和《马哈拉施特拉邦公寓法》的法律框架，分析合同法和物权法的相关规定。
AI.method: 法律文本分析，结合判例法和法律原则，探讨开发商与购房者之间的权利义务关系。
AI.findings: 开发商单方面组建公寓协会缺乏法律效力，必须获得100%原始购房者的明确同意，否则无权收取维护费等费用。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了MOFA向MAOA转换的法律要求，强调了购房者同意权的重要性，丰富了房地产法律理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为购房者提供了法律保护依据，规范了开发商行为，有助于减少房地产纠纷，维护市场秩序。

title: Urban Air Quality Transitions as Indicators of Governance Capacity: A Comparative Quantitative Assessment of Five Global Cities (2018–2022)
affiliations: Jamia Millia Islamia

detail.title: Urban Air Quality Transitions as Indicators of Governance Capacity: A Comparative Quantitative Assessment of Five Global Cities (2018–2022)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper."
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research is based on publicly available atmospheric data and personal field observations. It does not involve human participants, clinical trials, or sensitive personal data; therefore, formal ethics committee approval was not required."

detail.abstract: The 2020 COVID-19 lockdowns created a global "natural experiment" in atmospheric science, temporarily decoupling economic activity from environmental degradation. This study evaluates PM2.5 and NO₂ concentrations across five global megacities-New York, London, Delhi, Beijing, and Tokyo-between 2018 and 2022. By analyzing the "accidental" air quality gains of 2020 against the subsequent "rebound" in 2021-2022, the research demonstrates that long-term recovery is not a byproduct of technology alone but a direct indicator of institutional governance capacity. The study concludes that cities with robust regulatory enforcement maintained structural declines, while cities with reactive policies experienced a total return to pre-pandemic pollution levels.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用2020年COVID-19封锁作为自然实验，分析五大全球城市（纽约、伦敦、德里、北京、东京）在2018-2022年间的PM2.5和NO₂浓度变化，发现长期空气质量改善不仅依赖技术，更取决于制度治理能力。
AI.research_question: COVID-19封锁期间"意外"获得的空气质量改善在后续经济复苏中是否能够持续？哪些因素决定了空气污染水平的长期恢复模式？
AI.motivation: COVID-19封锁为研究经济活动和环境退化之间的脱钩提供了独特的自然实验机会，有助于理解在缺乏人为干预的情况下，空气质量改善的可持续性及其决定因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境治理理论、制度能力理论、反弹效应理论，以及经济发展与环境质量脱钩的理论框架。
AI.method: 比较案例研究法，分析五个全球大城市（纽约、伦敦、德里、北京、东京）在2018-2022年间的PM2.5和NO₂浓度数据，对比2020年封锁期间的"意外"改善与2021-2022年的"反弹"效应。
AI.findings: 1. 2020年所有城市都出现了空气质量显著改善；2. 2021-2022年恢复模式存在差异：具有强大监管执行力的城市（如伦敦、东京）保持了结构性下降，而采取反应性政策的城市（如德里）则完全恢复到疫情前污染水平；3. 长期恢复不是技术的副产品，而是制度治理能力的直接指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为环境治理中的制度能力理论提供了实证支持；2. 深化了对经济发展与环境质量脱钩机制的理解；3. 提出了"治理能力决定反弹效应"的新理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了证据：仅靠技术无法实现长期空气质量改善，需要强有力的制度治理；2. 识别了不同治理模式下城市环境恢复的差异；3. 为后疫情时代的环境政策设计提供了重要参考。

title: Functional Newton Solution for Heterogeneous-Agent DSGE Models Wealth Distribution and Consumption Dynamics in OECD Economies (2000-2025)
affiliations: University of Ain Temouchent

detail.title: Functional Newton Solution for Heterogeneous-Agent DSGE Models Wealth Distribution and Consumption Dynamics in OECD Economies (2000-2025)
detail.abstract: This study develops a nonlinear heterogeneous agent macroeconomic framework to analyze wealth distribution dynamics, consumption transmission mechanisms, and policy stabilization performance. The model integrates advanced numerical solution techniques based on Functional Newton equilibrium solvers to make large scale heterogeneous agent dynamic stochastic general equilibrium simulation computationally feasible. Simulation results for United States and selected advanced economies show that wealth heterogeneity plays a central role in determining macroeconomic volatility, fiscal multiplier effectiveness, and monetary policy transmission asymmetry. Tail households with high marginal propensity to consume generate nonlinear amplification effects in aggregate demand fluctuations, especially under liquidity constraint regimes. Policy experiment analysis demonstrates that distribution targeted fiscal interventions outperform uniform transfer policies in terms of welfare improvement, inequality reduction, and stabilization efficiency. Robustness tests confirm structural stability of the nonlinear dynamic system under variations in risk aversion, borrowing limits, and shock persistence parameters. Computational performance evaluation shows that the Functional Newton solution method provides fast convergence, high precision policy mapping, and scalable heterogeneous agent macroeconomic simulation capability. The framework enables realistic large scale welfare and distributional policy assessment. Overall, the research provides theoretical, numerical, and policy contributions to nonlinear macroeconomic modeling with heterogeneous agents.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个非线性异质代理人宏观经济框架，分析财富分布动态、消费传导机制和政策稳定绩效。模型整合了基于函数牛顿均衡求解器的高级数值解法，使大规模异质代理人动态随机一般均衡模拟计算可行。对美国及选定发达经济体的模拟结果显示，财富异质性在决定宏观经济波动、财政乘数有效性和货币政策传导不对称性中起核心作用。高边际消费倾向的尾部家庭在总需求波动中产生非线性放大效应，尤其在流动性约束机制下。政策实验分析表明，针对分布的财政干预在福利改善、不平等减少和稳定效率方面优于统一转移政策。
AI.research_question: 财富异质性如何影响宏观经济波动、政策传导机制和稳定绩效？针对分布的财政政策是否比统一转移政策更有效？
AI.motivation: 传统宏观经济模型往往忽视代理人异质性，特别是财富分布对宏观经济动态和政策效果的影响。需要开发能够处理大规模异质代理人、计算可行的非线性宏观经济框架，以更准确地分析财富分布动态、消费传导机制和政策稳定绩效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非线性异质代理人宏观经济框架，整合财富分布动态、消费传导机制和政策稳定分析。基于异质代理人动态随机一般均衡模型，强调财富异质性的核心作用，特别是尾部家庭的高边际消费倾向产生的非线性放大效应。
AI.method: 基于函数牛顿均衡求解器的高级数值解法，使大规模异质代理人动态随机一般均衡模拟计算可行。对美国及选定发达经济体进行模拟分析，包括政策实验、稳健性测试和计算性能评估。
AI.findings: 财富异质性在决定宏观经济波动、财政乘数有效性和货币政策传导不对称性中起核心作用。高边际消费倾向的尾部家庭在总需求波动中产生非线性放大效应，尤其在流动性约束机制下。针对分布的财政干预在福利改善、不平等减少和稳定效率方面优于统一转移政策。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了非线性异质代理人宏观经济建模的理论、数值和政策贡献。开发了计算可行的大规模异质代理人动态随机一般均衡框架，强调财富分布动态的核心作用，特别是非线性放大效应和流动性约束机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了针对分布的财政干预优于统一转移政策的实证依据。框架支持现实的大规模福利和分布政策评估，函数牛顿解法提供快速收敛、高精度政策映射和可扩展的异质代理人宏观经济模拟能力。

title: Incentive Design with Biased Reviewers and Compensation Committee
affiliations: Meiji University and Keio University - Graduate School of Business Administration

detail.title: Incentive Design with Biased Reviewers and Compensation Committee
detail.abstract: This paper studies incentive design in organizations that rely on subjective performance evaluation and bonus pools when evaluation is delegated to a potentially biased reviewer and overseen by a compensation committee. We develop a repeated-game model in which a principal commits to a single-step, fixed-sum reward scheme that splits a bonus pool between winners and losers. A reviewer observes a noisy, rank-based performance signal and proposes a permutation of prizes, which is implemented only if approved by a committee that follows a costly approval rule. Reviewer and agents interact repeatedly, so relational contracts discipline favoritism and shirking through continuation values. The single-step architecture yields a simple static backbone that maps the prize spread into equilibrium effort. Holding governance levers fixed, we first characterize an interior benchmark in which committee and governance costs alone determine the optimal prize spread and effort. We then derive a reviewer-constrained frontier that caps the maximum sustainable spread when the reviewer is tempted to favor preferred agents. The globally implementable spread is the minimum of these two and generates a regime classification. Comparative statics show how approval strictness, reviewer rotation, and evaluation coarseness jointly shape effort provision and the value of committee oversight.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了在主观绩效评估和奖金池制度下，当评估被委托给可能有偏见的评审者并由薪酬委员会监督时的激励机制设计。研究发现，通过单步固定总额奖励方案、委员会监督和重复博弈中的关系契约，可以平衡评审者的偏袒行为与代理人努力水平。
AI.research_question: 在主观绩效评估和奖金池制度下，当评估被委托给可能有偏见的评审者并由薪酬委员会监督时，如何设计有效的激励机制来平衡评审者的偏袒行为和代理人的努力水平？
AI.motivation: 许多组织依赖主观绩效评估和奖金池来激励员工，但评估过程可能被委托给有偏见的评审者。薪酬委员会的监督虽然能减少偏袒，但也带来成本。需要研究在这种复杂治理结构下如何设计有效的激励机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 重复博弈理论、关系契约理论、委托代理理论、激励机制设计理论
AI.method: 建立重复博弈模型，其中委托人承诺采用单步固定总额奖励方案，将奖金池在优胜者和失败者之间分配。评审者观察到有噪声的基于排名的绩效信号并提出奖金分配方案，该方案只有在遵循成本高昂的批准规则的委员会批准后才能实施。
AI.findings: 1. 单步架构产生简单的静态框架，将奖金差距映射到均衡努力水平；2. 在治理杠杆固定的情况下，存在一个内部基准，其中委员会和治理成本单独决定最优奖金差距和努力水平；3. 当评审者倾向于偏袒偏好的代理人时，存在一个评审者约束前沿，限制了最大可持续奖金差距；4. 全局可实施的奖金差距是这两个值中的最小值，并产生制度分类；5. 批准严格性、评审者轮换和评估粗糙度共同影响努力提供和委员会监督的价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了在主观绩效评估和奖金池制度下的激励机制设计理论；2. 将重复博弈和关系契约理论应用于组织治理问题；3. 提出了评审者约束前沿的概念，分析了偏袒行为对激励机制的限制；4. 建立了委员会监督成本与激励机制有效性之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为组织设计主观绩效评估系统提供指导；2. 帮助管理者理解如何平衡评审者偏袒与代理人激励；3. 为薪酬委员会的设计和运作提供理论依据；4. 提供了关于批准严格性、评审者轮换和评估粗糙度等治理杠杆如何影响激励效果的实践见解。

title: Execution Latency in Inventory Control: Extending Reorder Point Logic to Organizational Reality
affiliations: Chandigarh University

detail.title: Execution Latency in Inventory Control: Extending Reorder Point Logic to Organizational Reality

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declared no conflict of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable ( Conceptual Research)
declarations.funderStatement: This research does not received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Classical or Traditional inventory models such as Economic Reorder Quantity (EOQ) and Reorder Point (ROP) structures conjecture that replenishment actions are executed immediately once predefined thresholds or maybe a start point is reached. While this model is frequently used in all places but when seeing through mathematical sense or using a analytical thinking, this assumption frequently fails in practice, particularly in emergingmarket procurement environments where variables like hierarchical approvals, budget constraints, and procedural compliance play an important role in characterization of the process. As an outcome, the organization faces stockouts, emergency sourcing, and cost escalation even when the text book policies are accurately applied. This paper reasons that these failures origin from a systematic misunderstanding of lead time in classical inventory theory. This classical inventory models treat lead time only as an external variable factor, which is driven by the supplier. While abandoning predictable and deterministic variables such as internal decision delays immersed in organizational procurement process. Depicting on classical inventory theory, bounded rationality, and emerging-market supply chain literature, this study reimagines lead time as the sum of external supplier lead time and internal decision lead time. An execution-aware inventory structure is presented that differentiates between inventory signals that trigger organizational process and those that trigger order placement. New constructs or variables including the Execution Recognition Threshold (ERT), Authority-Constrained Order Quantity (ACOQ), and Emergency Risk Zone (ERZ)-are presented to capture the execution-level limitations or constraints faced by procurement professionals. And a numerical illustration that reveals that the classical inventory theory faced reorder points often initiate action only after the organization has entered a high-risk zone, while execution-aware triggers absorb internal delays without increasing safety stock. This study does not reject classical or traditional inventory theory and its models; rather, it extends them by aligning reorder logic with execution actuality. These finding call attention to the need to shift inventory control from buffer-based firefighting toward process-aware design, with suggestions for inventory theory, procurement practice, and supply chain education, particularly in emerging-market contexts.

AI.tldr: 传统库存模型假设补货行动在达到阈值时立即执行，但这在现实中常失败，特别是在新兴市场采购环境中。本文认为失败源于对提前期的系统性误解，将提前期重新定义为外部供应商提前期与内部决策提前期之和，提出了执行感知的库存结构。
AI.research_question: 为什么传统库存模型（如EOQ和ROP）在新兴市场采购环境中经常失败？如何通过重新定义提前期概念来改进这些模型？
AI.motivation: 传统库存模型假设补货行动在达到阈值时立即执行，但在实践中，特别是在新兴市场采购环境中，由于层级审批、预算约束和程序合规等因素，这一假设经常失败，导致缺货、紧急采购和成本上升。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经典库存理论、有限理性理论、新兴市场供应链文献
AI.method: 理论构建与数值模拟。提出了执行感知库存结构，引入新变量：执行识别阈值（ERT）、权限约束订单量（ACOQ）和紧急风险区（ERZ），并通过数值示例说明。
AI.findings: 传统库存模型的再订货点往往在组织已进入高风险区域后才触发行动，而执行感知触发器能够吸收内部延迟而不增加安全库存。
AI.theory_contributions: 将提前期重新定义为外部供应商提前期与内部决策提前期之和，扩展了经典库存理论；提出了执行感知库存结构和新变量（ERT、ACOQ、ERZ）。
AI.practical_contributions: 将库存控制从基于缓冲的应急反应转向过程感知设计；为新兴市场环境下的采购实践和供应链教育提供建议。

title: Algorithms, Biases, and Biryani: Behavioral Economics of Tinder in Urban Bangladesh
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Algorithms, Biases, and Biryani: Behavioral Economics of Tinder in Urban Bangladesh
detail.abstract:
This paper examines digital matchmaking in urban Bangladesh through the lens of behavioral economics, using Tinder as a case study of algorithm-mediated decision-making under social and cultural constraints. While online dating platforms are often modeled as efficient matching markets, user behavior in Bangladesh deviates systematically from classical rational-choice predictions due to stigma, reputational concerns, and family oversight. Drawing on a mixed-methods approach that combines survey evidence, platform usage patterns, and qualitative interviews with urban users, this study analyzes how cognitive biases and social heuristics shape participation and choice.

The findings highlight the presence of present bias, choice overload, anchoring effects, and gendered selection heuristics, all of which interact with Tinder’s algorithmic ranking system to produce suboptimal and asymmetric matching outcomes. Market frictions such as ghosting, selective engagement, and urban–rural pool imbalances further constrain matching efficiency. These dynamics suggest that algorithmic nudges may amplify existing behavioral biases rather than correct them, particularly in socially restrictive environments.

By situating digital dating within a culturally constrained decision-making framework, this paper extends behavioral economics and matching theory to a non-Western context. The study contributes empirical insights into how technology, social norms, and human biases jointly shape outcomes in emerging digital markets, with implications for platform design, user welfare, and policy considerations related to algorithmic mediation in social interactions

AI.tldr: 该研究通过行为经济学视角分析孟加拉国城市地区的Tinder数字匹配，发现社会文化约束导致用户行为偏离理性选择预测，认知偏差与算法系统相互作用产生次优匹配结果。
AI.research_question: 在孟加拉国这样的社会文化约束环境下，数字约会平台中的算法中介决策如何受到认知偏差和社会启发式的影响？这些因素如何与平台算法相互作用，最终影响匹配效率和结果？
AI.motivation: 虽然在线约会平台通常被建模为高效匹配市场，但在孟加拉国等非西方社会文化约束环境中，用户行为因污名化、声誉担忧和家庭监督等因素而系统性地偏离经典理性选择预测，需要研究技术、社会规范和人类偏差如何共同塑造新兴数字市场的结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学理论（包括认知偏差、社会启发式）、匹配理论、算法中介决策理论，以及文化约束决策框架。
AI.method: 混合方法研究：结合调查证据、平台使用模式分析，以及对孟加拉国城市用户的定性访谈。
AI.findings: 研究发现存在现时偏差、选择过载、锚定效应和性别化选择启发式，这些认知偏差与Tinder的算法排名系统相互作用，产生次优和不对称的匹配结果。市场摩擦如"幽灵行为"、选择性参与和城乡用户池不平衡进一步限制了匹配效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 将行为经济学和匹配理论扩展到非西方文化约束环境；将数字约会置于文化约束决策框架中分析；揭示了算法助推可能放大而非纠正现有行为偏差，特别是在社会限制性环境中。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台设计提供实证见解；对用户福利有重要启示；为算法中介在社会互动中的政策考量提供参考；帮助理解技术、社会规范和人类偏差如何共同塑造新兴数字市场结果。

title: Spacetime Governance Engineering: Relativistic Circuit Modeling and Stellar Energy Standards for Multi-Planetary Equilibrium (SBCM v4.0)
affiliations: SBCM Alliance

detail.title: Spacetime Governance Engineering: Relativistic Circuit Modeling and Stellar Energy Standards for Multi-Planetary Equilibrium (SBCM v4.0)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a theoretical and empirical study based on publicly available macroeconomic data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper proposes SBCM v4.0, a dimensional expansion of "Governance Engineering"—previously established for regional resource cycles (v2.0) and planetary geometric equilibrium (v3.0)—into a four-dimensional spacetime manifold. As humanity transitions into a multi-planetary civilization, contemporary economics faces the "Gravity Well Fallacy," which erroneously treats physical distance as a linear cost. We introduce the spacetime metric, based on General Relativity, as a direct economic metric, defining a cost function that integrates gravitational potential and proper time differentials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SBCM v4.0，将"治理工程"从区域资源循环（v2.0）和行星几何平衡（v3.0）扩展到四维时空流形，引入基于广义相对论的时空度量作为直接经济指标，解决人类向多行星文明过渡中的"重力井谬误"问题。
AI.research_question: 在人类向多行星文明过渡的背景下，如何将基于广义相对论的时空度量作为直接经济指标，以克服传统经济学中的"重力井谬误"？
AI.motivation: 随着人类向多行星文明过渡，传统经济学面临"重力井谬误"的挑战——错误地将物理距离视为线性成本，而实际上在引力场中时空是弯曲的，需要新的经济度量框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 广义相对论、时空流形理论、治理工程理论、多行星文明经济学、引力场中的成本函数理论。
AI.method: 提出SBCM v4.0框架，将治理工程扩展到四维时空流形，基于广义相对论定义时空度量，构建整合引力势和固有时微分的成本函数。
AI.findings: 建立了将时空度量直接作为经济指标的框架，定义了包含引力势和固有时微分的成本函数，为多行星文明的经济活动提供了更准确的计算基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将治理工程从三维空间扩展到四维时空流形；2) 引入基于广义相对论的时空度量作为经济指标；3) 提出克服"重力井谬误"的理论框架；4) 为多行星文明经济学奠定理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为星际贸易和资源分配提供更准确的经济计算工具；2) 帮助政策制定者更好地规划多行星文明发展；3) 为太空基础设施建设提供经济评估框架；4) 促进跨行星经济系统的协调发展。

title: Blowin' in the Wind? Adapting to Atlantic Basin Tropical Cyclones with Pesticides ⋆
affiliations: Deakin University

detail.title: Blowin' in the Wind? Adapting to Atlantic Basin Tropical Cyclones with Pesticides ⋆
detail.abstract:
Using U.S. county-level data, we uncover a relatively overlooked coping strategy employed by farmers in response to cyclones: selective increase of pesticide application. By constructing a novel dataset spanning 25 years of tropical cyclone activity, pesticide use, and agricultural output, our difference-in-differences design reveals that farmers respond to cyclone shocks by applying more pesticides to protect their crops. On average, a typical U.S. farm applies approximately 2,150–2,250 kg more pesticides in both the event year and the following - around ten times the normal annual quantity. While rising pesticide use poses health and environmental risks, our heterogeneity analysis offers a more nuanced view. Farmers
selectively boost pesticide applications to counter the rise in pests and pathogens that usually follow cyclones. They raise the use of lower-toxicity pesticides (e.g., 2,4-D, Metolachlor) but not highly hazardous ones (e.g., Chlorpyrifos), suggesting endogenous avoidance behavior consistent with risk awareness and regulatory constraints. These results hold robustly across eight measures of cyclone intensity, including rainfall, wind speed, and duration. In terms of coping mechanisms, farmers not only intensify pesticide use on existing crops but also expand their harvested acreage to compensate for yield losses, with effects lasting up to four years after a cyclone event. Overall, our results indicate that pesticide intensification, though adaptive in the short term, imposes considerable e and environmental trade-offs.

AI.tldr: 研究发现美国农民应对飓风冲击时会选择性地增加农药使用量，平均每个农场在飓风当年和次年多使用2150-2250公斤农药，约为正常年用量的10倍。虽然这会带来健康和环境风险，但农民主要增加低毒性农药而非高毒性农药，表明存在风险意识和规避行为。
AI.research_question: 农民如何应对飓风冲击？飓风是否导致农药使用量增加？农民在增加农药使用时是否有选择性？
AI.motivation: 气候变化导致极端天气事件（如飓风）频发，对农业生产造成冲击。现有研究主要关注农民的其他应对策略，但农药使用作为应对策略相对被忽视，需要探究飓风是否以及如何影响农药使用决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于风险管理理论和适应性行为框架，农民在面对气候冲击时会采取应对策略来保护作物和维持收入。风险意识和监管约束会影响农民的农药选择决策。
AI.method: 使用美国县级数据构建包含25年飓风活动、农药使用和农业产出的新数据集，采用双重差分法设计，分析飓风冲击对农药使用的影响，并进行异质性分析。
AI.findings: 1. 飓风导致农药使用量显著增加，平均每个农场多使用2150-2250公斤农药（约为正常年用量的10倍）；2. 农民有选择性地增加农药使用，主要增加低毒性农药（如2,4-D、Metolachlor），而非高毒性农药（如Chlorpyrifos）；3. 影响持续到飓风后4年；4. 农民还通过扩大种植面积来补偿产量损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 识别了农药使用作为农民应对气候冲击的重要策略；2. 揭示了农民在农药选择中的内生规避行为，符合风险意识和监管约束理论；3. 扩展了对农业适应性行为的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供关于气候适应策略的环境和健康影响证据；2. 有助于设计更可持续的气候适应政策；3. 强调需要平衡短期适应需求和长期环境可持续性。

title: Asset Prices, Bubbles and Monetary Policy
affiliations: The University of Tokyo

detail.title: Asset Prices, Bubbles and Monetary Policy
detail.abstract: In this paper, we provide a Dynamic New Keynesian (DNK) framework that incorporates rational asset bubbles into an economy featuring a financial accelerator mechanism driven by binding collateral constraints. Using this model, we revisit the debate on optimal monetary policy responses to asset prices and bubbles. In this economy, entrepreneurs possess heterogeneous efficiency in operating physical capital and face a collateral constraint that limits their borrowing capacity based on the value of their physical capital holdings. Intrinsically useless bubble assets are traded in the entrepreneur sector, which facilitate the transfer of resources from inefficient to efficient entrepreneurs, thereby sustaining a positive value. A central feature of the short-run economic dynamics is that both price of physical capital and bubbles interact with entrepreneurs' net worth, endogenously affecting the tightness of financial constraints. By minimizing the central bank's loss function, we find that the optimal policy response to the aggregate asset price index-comprising both value of physical capital and bubbles-is not uniform; it depends crucially on the source of exogenous shocks as well as the optimality of concurrent responses to inflation and the output gap, besides the relative weights assigned to the objectives under the central bank's dual mandate. Conversely, responding to asset bubbles in isolation is found to be suboptimal.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含理性资产泡沫的动态新凯恩斯主义框架，结合金融加速器机制，研究央行对资产价格和泡沫的最优货币政策反应。研究发现，对包含实物资本价值和泡沫的总体资产价格指数的反应不是统一的，取决于冲击来源和通胀、产出缺口的反应；而单独对泡沫反应是次优的。
AI.research_question: 在包含金融加速器机制和理性资产泡沫的动态新凯恩斯主义框架下，央行对资产价格和泡沫的最优货币政策反应是什么？
AI.motivation: 重新审视关于资产价格和泡沫的最优货币政策反应的争论，特别是在金融加速器机制和理性资产泡沫共存的经济环境中，为央行制定更有效的货币政策提供理论指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态新凯恩斯主义(DNK)框架，结合理性资产泡沫理论和金融加速器机制，企业家面临抵押约束，泡沫资产在企业家部门交易促进资源从低效向高效企业家转移。
AI.method: 构建理论模型，企业家具有异质性资本运营效率，面临基于实物资本价值的抵押约束，通过最小化央行损失函数分析最优货币政策反应。
AI.findings: 1. 对总体资产价格指数（包含实物资本价值和泡沫）的最优反应不是统一的，取决于外生冲击来源、通胀和产出缺口的反应优化程度，以及央行双重目标权重；2. 单独对资产泡沫反应是次优的。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将理性资产泡沫整合到金融加速器驱动的DNK框架中；2. 揭示了资产价格与企业家净资产相互作用影响金融约束的内生机制；3. 为资产价格反应政策提供了更细致的理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为央行制定资产价格反应政策提供决策框架；2. 强调需要考虑冲击来源和通胀、产出缺口反应的协调；3. 警告单独针对泡沫的政策可能是无效的。

title: Nominal Rigidities and the Taylor Principle under Fiscal Discipline with Long-maturity Nominal Debt

detail.title: Nominal Rigidities and the Taylor Principle under Fiscal Discipline with Long-maturity Nominal Debt

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no relevant financial or non-financial interests to disclose.
declarations.funderStatement: Keiichi Morimoto is supported by JSPS KAKENHI Grant Numbers JP24K04895 and JP23K25535.

detail.abstract: This paper studies equilibrium determinacy in a growing New Keynesian economy in which fiscal policy targets the face value debt-to-GDP ratio and the government issues long-maturity nominal debt. Because the monitored debt stock is insensitive to market valuation while issuance costs depend on bond prices, expectations-driven movements in long-bond prices induce fiscal adjustment that feeds back to capital accumulation and inflation. The determinacy region is bounded above by an admissible policy constraint. Local determinacy requires the inflation response to lie above a maturity-based cutoff and below this admissible upper bound, which can be close to one. A two-instrument extension with an ultra short bond shows how rollover exposure and portfolio shares shift both bounds. Numerical exercises show that determinacy may require an inflation coefficient only slightly above one together with a sizable output-gap response, and that longer maturity can tighten the determinate set relative to the flexible price benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在财政政策以面值债务-GDP比率为目标且政府发行长期名义债务的增长型新凯恩斯经济中的均衡确定性。由于被监控的债务存量对市场估值不敏感，而发行成本取决于债券价格，长期债券价格的预期驱动变动会引发财政调整，进而影响资本积累和通货膨胀。确定性区域受可接受政策约束的上限限制。局部确定性要求通胀反应高于基于期限的临界值并低于此可接受上限，该上限可能接近1。通过超短期债券的双工具扩展展示了展期风险和投资组合份额如何影响这两个边界。数值模拟表明，确定性可能仅需要略高于1的通胀系数加上可观产出缺口反应，且较长期限可能使确定性集相对于灵活价格基准更紧。
AI.research_question: 在财政政策以面值债务-GDP比率为目标且政府发行长期名义债务的增长型新凯恩斯经济中，均衡确定性条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统货币政策分析通常假设政府发行短期债务，但现实中政府发行长期名义债务，且财政政策常以面值债务-GDP比率为目标。这种政策组合对均衡确定性的影响尚未得到充分研究，特别是在债务存量对市场估值不敏感而发行成本取决于债券价格的情况下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 增长型新凯恩斯模型，结合财政政策以面值债务-GDP比率为目标，政府发行长期名义债务，考虑债务市场估值与财政调整的相互作用。
AI.method: 理论模型构建与分析，包括局部确定性条件推导、双工具扩展（超短期债券）、数值模拟验证。
AI.findings: 确定性区域受可接受政策约束的上限限制；局部确定性要求通胀反应高于基于期限的临界值并低于可接受上限；通过超短期债券扩展显示展期风险和投资组合份额影响两个边界；数值模拟表明确定性可能仅需略高于1的通胀系数加上可观产出缺口反应；较长期限可能使确定性集相对于灵活价格基准更紧。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了新凯恩斯模型中的均衡确定性分析，纳入长期名义债务和面值债务-GDP比率目标；揭示了债务期限结构对货币政策有效性的影响；提出了基于期限的确定性临界值概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中央银行制定货币政策提供理论指导，特别是在政府发行长期债务的情况下；帮助政策制定者理解债务期限结构对宏观经济稳定的影响；为财政与货币政策协调提供分析框架。

title:
The Irreducible Fee:
 Capital-at-Risk and the Floor on Financial Intermediation Costs
affiliations: Columbia University, University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title:
The Irreducible Fee:
 Capital-at-Risk and the Floor on Financial Intermediation Costs

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is President of Dromos Labs, a contributing company to the decentralized exchange Aerodrome Finance; this affiliation is disclosed as a potential conflict of interest. All empirical claims are derived from publicly available data and hold across protocols.

detail.abstract: In markets where intermediation requires deploying capital at risk under genuine uncertainty, the equilibrium price of intermediation has a strictly positive floor. Three channels contribute to this floor: (i) the participation constraint on risk-bearing capital, which requires compensation for irreducible risk (Sharpe, 1964); (ii) market clearing under finite capital supply, which prices the opportunity cost of balance sheet commitment; and (iii) the Grossman-Stiglitz (1980) information cost paradox, which prevents full revelation of costly-to-acquire information. AI-driven automation compresses transaction and information-processing costs but does not eliminate the underlying capital requirement, the scarcity of balance sheet, or the cost of producing genuinely new information. The binding constraint rotates across regimes—the participation constraint dominates in high-volatility environments, capital scarcity binds during balance-sheet contractions, and the information floor binds in opaque or novel markets—implying that the composite floor persists even when any individual channel is slack.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了在需要资本承担真实不确定性的中介市场中，中介价格的严格正下限。三个渠道共同形成这一下限：风险资本的参与约束、有限资本供给下的市场出清、以及Grossman-Stiglitz信息成本悖论。AI自动化压缩了交易和信息处理成本，但无法消除资本需求、资产负债表稀缺性或新信息生产成本。
AI.research_question: 在需要资本承担真实不确定性的中介市场中，中介价格的均衡下限是如何形成的？为什么即使AI自动化压缩了交易和信息处理成本，这一下限仍然存在？
AI.motivation: 理解中介服务价格的本质决定因素，特别是在AI和自动化技术快速发展的背景下，为什么某些中介成本无法被完全消除。这对于理解金融市场结构、金融中介的可持续性以及技术对金融体系的影响具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. Sharpe (1964) 的风险补偿理论（参与约束）；2. 有限资本供给下的市场出清理论；3. Grossman-Stiglitz (1980) 信息成本悖论；4. 资本稀缺性和资产负债表约束理论。
AI.method: 理论分析框架，结合金融经济学中的均衡定价理论，分析三个渠道对中介价格下限的贡献机制，并探讨不同市场环境下主导约束的变化。
AI.findings: 1. 中介价格存在严格正下限，由三个渠道共同决定；2. AI自动化只能压缩交易和信息处理成本，无法消除资本需求、资产负债表稀缺性和新信息生产成本；3. 主导约束随市场环境变化：高波动环境下参与约束主导，资产负债表收缩时资本稀缺性约束主导，不透明或新兴市场中信息成本约束主导。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了中介价格下限的复合理论框架；2. 整合了风险补偿、资本稀缺性和信息成本三个传统理论；3. 解释了为什么即使技术进步，某些中介成本仍然无法消除；4. 提供了约束条件随市场环境变化的动态分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为金融中介机构定价策略提供理论指导；2. 帮助投资者理解中介成本的本质；3. 为监管机构评估金融体系稳定性提供参考；4. 为技术公司（如AI金融科技）理解其技术局限性和市场机会提供洞见。

title: Nobel Peace Prize 2026 Food Security Defense Management and Rescue of Civilians and Children Facing Nuclear War and Genocide
affiliations: , Universitas Borobudur Jakarta, President Republik Indonesia, Universitas 17 Agustus 1945 Jakarta, Ministry of Primary and Secondary Education, Universitas Borobudur Jakarta, Independent and Universitas Pertahanan Indonesia

detail.title: Nobel Peace Prize 2026 Food Security Defense Management and Rescue of Civilians and Children Facing Nuclear War and Genocide

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors and nominators of this work declare that they have no commercial, financial, or personal conflicts of interest that could inappropriately influence the research, advocacy, or recommendations presented herein. This includes all activities related to food security defense, management, and the protection and rescue of civilians—particularly children—facing nuclear war, armed conflict, and acts of genocide. All work conducted, proposed, or documented for the Nobel Peace Prize 2026 nomination has been performed with the sole objective of advancing humanitarian protection, international peace, and the safeguarding of human rights, independent of any personal gain or organizational affiliation.
declarations.ethicsApproval: All research, advocacy, and humanitarian activities described in this submission were conducted in accordance with internationally recognized ethical standards, including the Declaration of Helsinki and relevant United Nations guidelines on human rights and protection of civilians. Where applicable, the study protocols and intervention strategies involving human subjects—including children and vulnerable populations affected by conflict—were reviewed and approved by [insert name of the relevant Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Ethics Committee].
